name: cancelʳ
rhs: λ x y → trans (+-assoc x (- y) y) (trans (cong (x +_) (+-inverseˡ y)) (+-identityʳ x))

name: reassoc
rhs: λ a b c → trans (+-assoc a (- b) (b + - c)) (trans (cong (a +_) (sym (+-assoc (- b) b (- c)))) (trans (cong (a +_) (cong (λ z → z + - c) (+-inverseˡ b))) (cong (a +_) (+-identityˡ (- c)))))
